title: Unsupported softprops/action-gh-release runtime
summary: This release predates the action's Node.js 24 runtime. GitHub no longer provides Node.js 20 on Actions runners.

sources.title: Node 20 is no longer available in GitHub Actions

constraints: Preserve the release tag, name, notes, draft and prerelease flags, and the files to upload; the job still needs contents: write.

steps.title: Upgrade action-gh-release
steps.instructions: Change the uses reference to softprops/action-gh-release@v3 or a later supported major.

steps.title: Review action-gh-release inputs
steps.instructions: Compare configured inputs with the target release and update renamed or changed options; confirm the runner meets the release's minimum version.
